g2-implement.title: Item 3: FastF1 version-guard hardening — implement
g2-implement.imperative: Crew gate. Fill IMPLEMENTER_HANDOFF.template.md and dispatch an implementer subagent. Task: In src/preprocessing/trajectory/loaders.py, harden the FastF1 version guard. Specifically: (1) Add a module-level constant _FASTF1_MIN_VERSION = '3.0.0'. (2) Add a module-level _check_fastf1_version() function that imports fastf1, compares fastf1.__version__ to the minimum using packaging.version or manual tuple parse, and calls logger.warning if the installed version is below the minimum. Call it once at the bottom of the module-level definitions (not at import time — defer to first use, or call lazily). (3) In load_session_offline, replace the silent 'except AttributeError: pass' for fastf1.Cache.offline_mode with a logged warning: 'fastf1.Cache.offline_mode not available in this fastf1 version; session may attempt network requests.' This is a documentation-class code change that adds observability without changing behavior. CONSTRAINTS: do NOT change function signatures, return types, or behavior. Do NOT touch smoother.py or src/physics/*. EVIDENCE: run py -m src.utils.simplification_limits --paths src/preprocessing/trajectory/loaders.py and py -m pytest tests/unit/preprocessing/ -q.

triage_candidates.title: GP-name normalization: incomplete strip in f1_calendar.py + no shared util
triage_candidates.detail: f1_calendar.py strips ' Grand Prix' suffix (line 87-88) but does not handle adjective forms ('Belgian Grand Prix' -> 'Belgian', not 'Belgium'). loaders.py callers currently know the DB-canonical name so there is no active failure, but the gap is real. A shared normalizer in src/utils/ would prevent future per-caller mapping. Item 2 honest-null: no current preprocessing caller needs the bridge.
